title: Frontend: Acronym Generator
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind Acronym Generator. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Export App. Return uppercase initials of whitespace-separated words, ignoring surrounding whitespace; a blank phrase returns an empty string. Render controlled labelled inputs with these exact names: Phrase. A Calculate submit button computes the result. Render JSON.stringify(result) in [data-testid="result"]. Validation failure clears result and shows the documented message in [data-testid="error"].
constraints: Export default App. Only react and react/jsx-runtime imports are supported. The DOM contract and supplied props define the exercise.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
Normalize leading/trailing whitespace, split on runs of whitespace, discard empty segments, and take the first code point of each remaining token.
alternativeApproaches: Offer a configurable stop-word list while retaining a clear preview of which words contributed initials.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: Blank phrase; extra spaces; a single word.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
